Draw from the prior associated with a fitted model

Source: R/checks.R
sample_prior.Rd

The prior fit uses the same locations, scaling, and prior settings as ibmfit, but omits the observation likelihood.

Usage

sample_prior(
  ibmfit,
  iter = 1000,
  chains = 2,
  cores = getOption("mc.cores", chains),
  ...
)

Arguments

ibmfit

An ibmfit object returned by ibm().

iter, chains, cores

Stan sampling controls for the prior fit.

...

Additional arguments passed to rstan::sampling(), such as seed or refresh.

Value

An ibmfit containing prior draws.
